prompt: Lambda ko handler kyun nahi mila?
title: Lambda ko handler kyun nahi mila?

script.title: Lambda ko handler kyun nahi mila?

dialogue.speaker: jack
dialogue.text: Hosted API live kiya, aur har request pe five hundred error aa raha tha. Shuru se dekhte hain.

dialogue.speaker: jack
dialogue.text: API Gateway request Lambda ko deta hai. Lambda humari Docker image chalata hai, jismein AWS ka runtime client hai.

dialogue.speaker: jack
dialogue.text: Runtime client ko batana padta hai kaunsa handler load kare. Humne image ke command mein argument diya: cloud dist api dot handler.

dialogue.speaker: jack
dialogue.text: Argument diya, phir bhi error aaya: cannot find module api. Socho, kyun?

pause.prompt: We passed the handler as an argument. Why can't the runtime find it?
choices: Version 4 ignores the argument and reads env variables
API Gateway sent the wrong path

dialogue.speaker: jack
dialogue.text: Runtime client ka version chaar argument dekhta hi nahi. Woh sirf underscore HANDLER aur LAMBDA TASK ROOT environment variables padhta hai.

dialogue.speaker: jack
dialogue.text: Fix ek chhota bootstrap file hai. Woh argument ko underscore HANDLER mein daalta hai, task root set karta hai, phir runtime client start karta hai.

dialogue.speaker: jack
dialogue.text: Locally wahi environment variables set karke test kiya. Sahi handler load hua, aur galat naam pe wahi purana error aaya.

dialogue.speaker: jack
dialogue.text: Deploy ke baad health check do sau deta hai. Lesson: runtime ka version badle, toh uska startup contract dobara padho.

script.takeaway: aws-lambda-ric 4 reads _HANDLER and LAMBDA_TASK_ROOT, not the command argument, so a tiny bootstrap sets them first.

questions.prompt: Why did the Lambda fail to find the handler?
choices: The handler file was missing from the image
API Gateway called the wrong route
questions.explanation: The command argument was ignored; the runtime needed environment variables, which the bootstrap now sets.

prompt: Login ho gaya, phir bhi invalid?
title: Login ho gaya, phir bhi invalid?

script.title: Login ho gaya, phir bhi invalid?

dialogue.speaker: jhaplu
dialogue.text: Paplu, maine terminal se login kiya, Google pe sign in bhi ho gaya. Phir bhi likha aaya, invalid Cognito sign-in configuration!

dialogue.speaker: paplu
dialogue.text: Google login sahi tha, Jhaplu. Galti humare check mein thi. Hum token ka issuer ek regex se verify karte hain, taaki koi nakli server token na de sake.

dialogue.speaker: jhaplu
dialogue.text: Par URL toh asli Cognito ka hi tha na? Regex ko usmein kya bura laga?

dialogue.speaker: paplu
dialogue.text: Pool ID dekho. ap south one, underscore, Q I Y a O two Hex. Usmein capital letters hain.

dialogue.speaker: jhaplu
dialogue.text: Achha. Toh jab regex ne capital Q aur capital I dekhe, tab usne kya kiya?

pause.prompt: The regex only allows lowercase. What happens to the real pool ID ap-south-1_QIYaO2Hex?

dialogue.speaker: paplu
dialogue.text: Asli pool ko bhi reject kar diya. Humare tests mein sirf chhote letters wale fake IDs the, isliye ye kabhi pakda hi nahi gaya.

dialogue.speaker: jhaplu
dialogue.text: Toh regex hi hata kyun nahi dete? Jhanjhat khatam ho jaayega na?

dialogue.speaker: paplu
dialogue.text: Nahi, check zaroori hai. Naya regex region ka format aur pool ID ke capital letters maanta hai. Test mein asli ID bhi hai, aur ek nakli domain bhi jo fail hona chahiye.

script.takeaway: Validate tokens against real production values: a lowercase-only pattern rejected the real Cognito pool ID.

questions.prompt: Why did the real sign-in fail?
choices: The issuer check only allowed lowercase, but the pool ID has capitals
questions.explanation: The pattern was written against lowercase test data, so the real mixed-case pool ID failed.

script.title: Naya AWS account, website kahan host karein?

tierlist.criterion: live today, with Google sign-in, on a new account

dialogue.speaker: badri
dialogue.text: Website ko ek naye AWS account pe host karna tha. Criterion ek hi hai: aaj hi live ho, Google login ke saath.

dialogue.speaker: badri
dialogue.text: Plan tha S3 plus CloudFront. Par naye account pe CloudFront ne bola, account must be verified. Aaj ke liye seedha F tier.

dialogue.speaker: badri
dialogue.text: Ab S3 static website. Ek minute mein ban jaata hai. Par ek dikkat hai. Socho, kaunsi?

pause.prompt: S3 website hosting goes live instantly. What breaks for Google sign-in?
choices: It is HTTP only, and the sign-in redirect needs HTTPS

dialogue.speaker: badri
dialogue.text: S3 website sirf HTTP deta hai, aur Cognito ka login redirect HTTPS maangta hai. Site khulegi, login nahi hoga. D tier.

dialogue.speaker: badri
dialogue.text: Amplify Hosting. Build ka zip upload kiya, HTTPS wala URL mila, aur Google login chal gaya, isi naye account pe. S tier.

dialogue.speaker: badri
dialogue.text: Takeaway: plan mein ek fallback rakho. Naye account ki limits deploy ke din hi pata chalti hain.

script.takeaway: Keep a fallback in the plan: a brand-new AWS account's limits show up on deploy day.

title: Paise kat gaye, khareed gayab!

dialogue.speaker: jhaplu
dialogue.text: Mamu, samose ka payment ho gaya, par order history khaali! Apun buy wala button dobara daba de?

dialogue.speaker: paplu
dialogue.text: Re baba, pehle payment aur order verify kar! Write primary database pe gaya, par history read replica se aa rahi hai. Replica ko update milne mein delay ho sakta hai. Empty history ka matlab failed order nahi.

dialogue.text: Phir saara load udhar jayega. Abhi purchase confirmation aur apne recent order ko primary se read kara. Jahan thoda stale data chale, wahan replica ka benefit le. Har read ko same consistency nahi chahiye.

prompt: Natural conversational Hinglish AI reliability skit. Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2005.11401 . Retrieval-augmented generation supplies external evidence but doesn't guarantee correctness. Diagnose retrieval coverage, require attributable support, verify outputs and allow abstention. A confident generated claim or invented citation is not evidence.
title: AI ne jawaab bhi banaya, saboot bhi!

script.title: AI ne jawaab bhi banaya, saboot bhi!

dialogue.speaker: john
dialogue.text: Mere AI ne confident answer aur book ka reference de diya. John banega don! Par book mein woh fact mil hi nahi raha?

brollSequence.title: A screenshot of ChatGPTs response to reading the datacsv file and writing an R code fig2 371651458 — researchgate.net

dialogue.speaker: jhatka
dialogue.text: Oye mere yaar, confidence evidence nahi hota! Pehle check kar model ko relevant passage mila bhi tha? Ho sakta hai answer ke saath citation bhi bana diya ho.

dialogue.speaker: john
dialogue.text: Relevant passage bheja hi nahi tha. Ab poori book prompt mein daal doon, hallucination band?

dialogue.speaker: jhatka
dialogue.text: Aisa hota toh meri har machine first try mein chalti! Relevant passage retrieve kar, phir answer ke claims ko us passage se verify kar. Retrieval fail hua ya answer generation, dono ko alag test kar.

dialogue.speaker: john
dialogue.text: Aur retrieved passage mein bhi answer na ho toh? Jaldi bolo, time kam hai!

dialogue.speaker: jhatka
dialogue.text: Tab insufficient evidence bolna valid answer hai. Question clarify kar ya aur sources dhoondh. Citation ka naam dekhkar trust mat kar; claim support hota hai ya nahi, woh check kar. Kasam mere mareezon ki, RAG bhi truth ki magic stamp nahi!
